name: Foam Roller Calves
how_to:
1. Setup: Sit on the floor with your legs extended and place a foam roller horizontally under your calves.
2. Support Your Upper Body: Place your hands on the floor behind you and lift your hips slightly so your weight shifts onto the foam roller.
3. Begin Rolling: Roll slowly from the bottom of the calf (just above the ankle) to the top (below the knee) using small forward and backward movements.
4. Apply Pressure: To increase pressure, cross one leg over the other so more weight is placed on the lower calf.
5. Target Trigger Points: If you find a tender or tight spot, pause and hold for 10–20 seconds until the tension reduces.
6. Repeat: Continue rolling for 20–40 seconds per leg, switching sides as needed.
